contexts.text: The correspondence (of odours) may be evident from the spheres in Heaven... There are spheres of love and faith there which are manifestly perceived. The spheres are such that when a good Spirit, or an Angel, or a Society, approaches, their quality as to love and faith is at once perceived, even from afar... To these spheres correspond the spheres of odours in the world... for spheres of love and faith (can be) turned into spheres of sweet and pleasing odours. AC 950. AC 1514.

A sphere exhales from (a man's, or a Soul's) nature, that is, from all the several things in him. This sphere is such that from it is perceived the faith and charity in which he is. This sphere... becomes visible as a rainbow. AC 1053, Explained.

They thus acquire two spheres... one interior, full of hatreds; the other exterior, simulative of good. These spheres fight with each other, (and) when the exterior sphere is taken away... they rush into all wickedness. When it is not taken away, hatred lurks in every word; this is perceived; hence their punishments.
There exhaled from (the antediluvians) a sphere of a cadaverous stench...
When (the antediluvians) were in the World of Spirits, the constitution of the sphere there was changed.

That which is regnant in a man manifests itself (there) by a sphere, which is perceived by all around him. This sphere is such because it exhales from all the several things in him. The sphere of one who regards himself in everything... absorbs everything which is of advantage to him, thus all the delight of the Spirits around him, and destroys all their freedom...
On spheres in the other life. General article. AC 1504, continued. SE 3333, General article.
Hence evil Spirits cannot approach a sphere... where are good ones. Described.
The (evil) Spirits could not stay in the sphere of the Angel... Yet the sphere of that Angel had been tempered by consociations of others, (otherwise) they would all have been dissipated.
The sphere (of the unconscious activity of a man's interiors) extends to a distance; and sometimes... is presented before the senses.
How these spheres... are acquired. Example(s).
This makes a sphere (there), which is perceived... when the Lord permits.
Therefore there are as many spheres as affections, and compositions of affections.
One's sphere is his image extended outside of him: it is an image of all things in him. Explained.
One who had acquired a sphere of (self) excellence. The Spirits fled... and he himself filled the whole surrounding sphere...

(Another) had contracted a sphere of supereminence and authority. A dark cloud was seen to go forth from him, and cover the Spirits over... They could not stay; for they were deprived of all freedom...

Those endowed with high rank cannot help acquiring a sphere of authority... In those gifted with faith and charity, this sphere of authority is wonderfully conjoined with a sphere of goodness... But these have not a sphere of commanding; but only the sphere natural to them... which they (afterwards) put off... (See SE 2699, where this sphere is further described and Solomon is mentioned as an example.) SE 3167.
(A sphere of doing nothing from the luxurious. Described.) The feet of their sphere on me was to... induce torpor. Described.
Every Spirit, and still more every Society... has its own sphere... which is a sphere of principles and persuasions. Genii have a sphere of cupidities.
The sphere of principles and persuasions is such that when it acts into another it makes truths as falsities... AC 1511.
Such spheres are denser according to the nature of the Falsities.

These spheres cannot at all agree with the spheres of Spirits who are in truths: if they approach each other, there arises a repulsion. If the sphere of falsity... prevails, the good come into temptation...
A sphere of incredulity. Described. SE 3335. SE 3520. Explained.
Also a sphere of those who believe only what they apprehend by the senses.
So Genii, by their sphere, produce exactly the effect that evil is good.
Spheres of phantasies... appear like clouds. Described.
From those in hatred and revenge exhale spheres which cause swooning, and vomiting. AC 1513, Example(s).
These spheres are... poisonous. Their poisonousness and grossness are tested by dull blue bands: as these vanish, the sphere is diminished.
(Examples of the odours of various spheres. See Odour.) AC 1517. AC 1519.
(The deadly stench of the sphere of Sirens, Described.)
Spheres of Angels are sometimes presented visible as beautiful atmospheres...
The spheres of Spirits are not constantly perceptible. They are also tempered in various ways, in order that the quality of Spirits may not always be exposed.
This is the sphere which reigns in the universal Heaven.
They exhale a sphere of stinking teeth.
Unclean things exhale from them when they approach a sphere of good Spirits.
Until man acquires spheres (of cupidities and Falsities) evil Spirits serve; but as soon as he acquires them, they pour in upon him... for they are then in his very sphere...
From the very sphere of a man who is confirmed in truth, and good, evil Spirits know... what answer they will get...
The words were below their sphere.
How powerful in its effects is the sphere of Sirens.
Their sphere is one of self-Regard.
The interiors are there manifested by the sphere diffused from them.
(The state of the interior sphere of the World of Spirits before the Last Judgment.)
Such fill the exterior and interior sphere of the World of Spirits.
Divine things are above the sphere of the understanding of human rational truth.
When the infants are in... the angelic sphere, they cannot be infested...
I perceived from his sphere his disposition to domineer, etc.
When the sense of the letter ascends... to the sphere in which Angels are... AC 3954.
They filled the sphere with mere scandals.
An impious sphere exhales from the life of their will and derivative thought...
When celestial and spiritual things descend from Heaven into a lower sphere... they present a marriage. AC 2728:end. AC 2729.
But, when they are perverted in the lower sphere...
The things of the interior memory manifest themselves there by a certain sphere, by which the Spirits are Known at a distance...
This sphere comes forth from the activity of the Things in the interior memory.
The Angels are encompassed by a celestial and spiritual sphere which is full of the Lord; (thus) they are in Him.
(How a sphere of perception is acquired.)
There is an interior sphere in which such Spirits and Genii are. Signified.
When Angels are speaking about doctrine, the idea of a city appears in a lower sphere... (See also AC 3217. AC 3218.)
When infernals approach a sphere where are good and truth, they feel their own Hell... AC 3938:6.
When the Lord is named (there), a sphere of contempt and aversion is exhaled from them...
I have perceived the Divine sphere of ends and uses... Everything Hows forth from this sphere, and is ruled through it.
Thus man can be in the Divine sphere of ends and uses, which... constitutes Heaven; but beasts can be in no other sphere than one of earthly ends and uses.
Hence they are in the Divine sphere of the Lord, and of His ends and uses.
Love to the Lord and the neighbour makes all the sphere of life... there; (and these) cannot breathe in such a sphere...
The heavenly form in the lowest sphere. Described.
The brain, like Heaven, is in the sphere of ends which are uses...
As soon as (these Spirits) approach, their sphere operates. Described.

All thought is (there) communicated by a certain sphere which proceeds from the other, and manifests the quality of his... will and thought; and therefore conjunction is effected according to the sphere.
A corporeal sphere exhaled from him.
The misty and dark sphere which exhales from the evils and falsities of the infernals, appears like a mountain, or rock, under which they are hidden.
A sphere exhales from such a man's interiors which Spirits perceive as plainly as a man does a stench... AC 4464:2.
When they came into the sphere of their thoughts, they began to breathe with difficulty.
For there are spheres of thoughts and affections there, which are mutually communicated according to presence...

If a man's life has been in... hatreds, revenges, adulteries, avarice, deceits, luxury, etc. the spiritual sphere which encompasses him is as foul as is the sphere of the odour from carcasses, ordure, etc. The man who has led such a life carries this sphere with him after death; and, as he is wholly in this sphere, he cannot be anywhere but in Hell...

But those who have had delight in benevolence, charity, and most especially... in love to the Lord, are encompassed with a grateful and pleasant sphere, which is the heavenly sphere itself, and therefore they are in Heaven.
All the spheres which are perceived (there) arise from the loves and derivative affections in which they had been...
A man's ends determine his life... thence especially, is his sphere. This sphere is perceived in Heaven most exquisitely; because the universal Heaven, is in the sphere of ends.

When any Spirit is approaching, even distantly and secretly, his presence is perceived, when the Lord grants, from a spiritual sphere; and from it is known the quality of his life, affection, and faith... AC 5189, Example(s).
These spheres, when the Lord pleases, are turned into odours. Explained. AC 4628, Example(s).
The sphere of the love of the celestial Angels is tempered (by other Angels), otherwise it would cause those to whom they are sent to swoon; for the sphere of their love penetrates to the marrows.
The sphere which encompasses such appears like thick sediment.
They are covered with a cloud, which is the sphere of wickedness exhaling from them.
When they perceive the sphere of one whom they had hated, they become infuriated.
All are there Known, as to their faith and love, from their spheres...
That which reigns universally with anyone produces this sphere...
A sphere of faith from charity is the sphere which reigns in Heaven...
Their sphere induced anxiety (because) it did not agree with the spheres of the Spirits with me.
A conversation about spheres.

There are many spiritual spheres around a man... Some spheres from the Spiritual World are around a man which agree with his life, and through these spheres he is in Society with Spirits of a like affection. Hence arise many things... for example, what is ascribed to fortune, (which is really) from a spiritual sphere.
The good and truth of the Angels... are also perceived from the spheres which are from them.
(The law which governs the proximity of the sphere of falsity in the other life. See Falsity.)
Scarcely anyone can know (this), unless he is in a spiritual sphere...

Angels and good Spirits are in a spiritual sphere (and therefore) to think of such things is delicious to them; whereas to one who is in a natural sphere, and still more to one in a sensuous sphere... such things are irksome.
The sphere which encompasses one in temptation, or vastation, appears like a mist exhaled from dirty places.
To think of such things is very delightful to them, for they are in the Divine sphere of the Lord, thus as it were in Him. Described.
Who and of what quality anyone had been, is plainly perceived there from the sphere of the life of their affections and thoughts. Example(s). AC 5432:3, Example(s).
(A thing) is clothed for use in a lower sphere... with such things as are in the lower sphere, in order that the internal thing from which it proceeds, may act in the lower sphere.

For what is interior is in a purer sphere, and what is exterior is in a grosser one; and that which is in a purer sphere is capable of receiving distinctly a thousand things more than that which is in a grosser sphere. Example(s).
When his sphere operated, it induced a great oppression in the stomach.
An unclean sphere corresponding to the disease at once adjoins itself...
Through those Spirits was communicated the sphere of the exhalations from (their Hells). (Its effect on the body.)
The sphere of a man's whole life which exhales from him is from (what is regnant in him). Example(s).
This (deceitfulness) is perceived from their sphere.
The Spirits who were in a more subtle sphere...
The Hell in the sphere of which the man then is...
When a man appropriates an evil, he acquires a sphere of that evil, and to this sphere there adjoin themselves Spirits from Hell who are in a sphere of the like evil.
The spiritual sphere with a man or Spirit is an exhalation flowing forth from the life of his loves...

All (there) are conjoined or dissociated according to the spheres, even Societies. Opposite spheres collide, and repel each other. Hence the spheres of the loves of evil are all in Hell, and the spheres of the loves of good are all in Heaven; that is, those who are in them.

There are Hells which are in a more subtle sphere. Described... This sphere inflows into the external sensuous sphere from the back part where are the involuntary things. Hence the sensuous sphere is so strong.
(An infernal) cannot endure the sphere of celestial love... To him this sphere is like a burning fire.
For years I have observed a general sphere of influxes around me. Explained.
When an evil accident happens, it is because the sphere of such Spirits has prevailed. Evil Spirits have found out how to produce a sphere which causes misfortunes...
In the Spiritual World, man is in the sphere of his interiors.
This is evident from the sphere which exhales from such from afar; for their quality is perceived from it. This sphere is like a spiritual evaporation from all the several things of the life.
That the spheres of the thoughts and affections extend themselves around into the spheres of remote Societies. Example(s).

These thoughts and affections enter (merely) the universal sphere of the affection and derivative thought of those Societies... For the spiritual sphere in which all Societies are is various with each, and when thoughts and affections enter into this sphere, the Societies are not affected. All thoughts and affections enter into the spheres of Societies with which they agree. Explained.
(This) may be evident from the density of the sphere in which are sensuous Spirits; and from the purity of the sphere in which are Angels.

Around every man, and every good Spirit, there is a general sphere of endeavours from Hell, and a general sphere of endeavours from Heaven. Explained... These are general spheres: there are also particular spheres around every man. Explained... Hence man is in equilibrium... AC 8209, Explained.
They go outside the sphere of this solar system... AC 6927.
Outside the sphere where are Spirits of our Earth.

Every Spirit, and still more every Society, is surrounded by a sphere of its own faith and life = a spiritual sphere. By this sphere their quality is known; for it is perceived by those in perception, sometimes at a considerable distance, even when they are hidden, and not communicating by thought or speech.
This spiritual sphere may be compared to the material sphere which encompasses a man's body, which is a sphere of effluvia... and is smelled by keen-scented beasts.
(Thus) if infernals were near those in Divine worship, they would infest them by their sphere; for (the latter) would perceive something abominable.

From what has been said about (this) spiritual sphere... it is evident that there is nothing hidden... of whatever a man had thought, spoken, or done (here); for these are the things which constitute that sphere.
Such a sphere pours from a man's spirit even while he is in the body; and his quality is thereby Known. Illustrated.
While Spirits of Mars occupied the sphere of my mind...
(The Divine truth) may be illustrated by the sphere of charity and faith which proceeds from the Angels... AC 9407:13.

Every truth has its own extension, which is sometimes manifested by a sphere... The sphere of the extension (there) is to the surrounding Societies. Wherever the sphere extends itself, so far there is communication. (Continued. See Extend.)
The things a man... entirely believes and loves are perpetually in his thought and will... as is manifest from the spiritual sphere around a Spirit. Explained.
Falsities and evils cannot enter into the sphere where are good and truth. Signified.
The falsities pouring from their evils then constitute a sphere around them, which appears like a dense cloud, or water.
Spheres, called spiritual spheres, continually emane from every Society; they pour out. These spheres are from the activity of their affections and derivative thoughts.
The consociations (there) are all made according to the spheres. Explained.
Each province in the Grand Man has its own distinct sphere...
Hence there is an oppugnancy between the spheres.
In the inmost sphere of Heaven there is a certain progression according to the Divine heavenly form...
Extension into Heaven (only) to the spiritual spheres of good. Signified, Explained.
Every Angel, Spirit, and man has a spiritual sphere, which is according to his extension into Societies... not into the Societies themselves, but into the spheres of their good.
The dominant love constitutes the sphere of everyone's life, and it extends itself according to its quality and quantity.
By the spiritual sphere of good ceasing below. Signified, Explained.
When the sphere of their life does not agree (with the Societies into which they are admitted) conflict ensues...
When a (merely) natural man comes into the spiritual sphere, which is the sphere of life of the internal man, he is insane. AC 9109:2.
Such are in pain and blindness when elevated into the spiritual sphere.
Their truths ate Known from their faces... and the good itself from them.
Three things with an Angel make a one: his internal... his external... and the sphere of the life of his affections and thoughts, which pours out from him to a distance.
The Divine sphere which proceeds from the Lord, called the Divine truth, is universal, filling the universal Heaven...
A sphere of affections of good and truth is presented before (their) eyes by colours, the specific things by objects variously coloured; and also before the nostrils, by odours.
The power of the Divine sphere. Signified, Explained.

The Divine truth... must be conceived as a sphere from the Sun, decreasing in ardour... as it recedes... Within this sphere, but far from the Sun... is the angelic Heaven. This sphere extends itself also outside of Heaven, even into Hell; but those there... turn it into the contrary.
The sides of the ark = the Divine sphere encompassing Heaven in its ultimates. Explained.
Through the Divine sphere of good and truth which encompasses and encloses Heaven in general and particular has Heaven been created... and through the same it is conserved...
The termination of the sphere of good from the Divine good. Signified, Explained. AC 9535.

The Divine sphere which encompasses and guards Heaven is a sphere of Divine truth conjoined with Divine good; but the sphere which guards Hell is a sphere of Divine truth separated from Divine good. Explained.
(Thus the former) sphere ceases where Heaven ceases; and (the latter) sphere begins where Hell begins; and in the intervening space there is a conjunction. Signified.
Firmness is in the natural sphere. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction of the one sphere with the other. Signified, Explained.

In Heaven, spheres conjoin; for spheres proceed from every Society, and from every Angel. These spheres exhale from the life of each one's affections of good and truth, and pour themselves out thence to a distance... The Angels and Societies are conjoined, and also disjoined, according to these spheres. Explained.
So far as these spheres derive from the Lord, they conjoin; so far as from an Angel's proprium, they disjoin.
Plenary conjunction in the ultimates of the spheres. Signified, Explained.
Plenary conjunction of one sphere with the other. Signified, Explained.
The sphere of good through which there is conjunction. Signified, Explained.
The power of the sphere of Divine good. Signified, Explained.
Not only Heaven, but all the Societies, and also each Angel... are encompassed with the Divine sphere, which is the good and truth proceeding from the Lord...
The sphere of Divine good through which there is conjunction from the higher part of Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction of the sphere of Divine good in the extremes of Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The conjunction and conservation of all things of Heaven through the sphere of Divine good in the externals of the Spiritual Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
What is perpetual and impressed on hearts according to the heavenly sphere. Signified, Explained.

The love constitutes the whole man there, and the derivative sphere of life flows forth from him like an exhalation or vapour, and encompasses him, and makes as it were himself around him... like the effluvium around plants... and beasts... Such an effluvium pours out of every man... But (after death) this effluvium... is not material... but is a spiritual effluence from his love, which forms a sphere around him...
As this sphere is communicated to others, and is transferred into them... and is received by them according to their love, it gives rise to many wonderful things there. Enumerated.
From the spheres of their affections... their quality as to love is perceived.
For evils cannot endure the sphere of good. Described, Signified.
The sphere of Divine good through which there is conjunction and conservation. Signified, Explained.
The sphere of Divine good infils universal Heaven, and extends itself into Hell; for it is like the sphere of the sun's heat...
This Divine sphere has been likened to radiant circles...
They who suffer themselves to be led by the Lord... are in the sphere of Divine good... (others) are in the same sphere, but their interiors are closed so that they do not feel the influx...
Hence the external sphere of Divine good is dulled in Hell, yet the internal sphere remains, which is not received... but still the Lord rules the Hells through it.
The reason why there is a sphere of Divine good. Explained.

Moreover, from every Angel proceeds a sphere from his love; and also from every good or evil Spirit, according to their loves; but the spheres proceeding from these do not extend themselves far; but the Divine sphere into the universe; for it proceeds from the inmost, which is the all in all the successives.
Concerning these spheres. References.

Thus the Divine sphere round about is a sphere of the good of love from the Lord as a Sun from the east even to the west, and a sphere of truth from good from the south to the north. Thus the sphere of Divine good in the midst is like an axis, and the sphere of Divine truth thence proceeding is on both sides. Signified.
Anxiety was felt, arising from a collision of the spheres. Explained.
Spiritual spheres of life proceed from every Angel and Spirit... by which their quality is known. Explained.
The spheres which go forth from the Angels are so full of love that...
All the Societies communicate by an extension of the spheres.
The sphere of the life is a sphere of the affections which are of love and faith. This extends itself into the Societies. Described.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. A spiritual sphere, which is a sphere of the life, flows forth from every man. Spirit, and Angel. References.
The things above the sphere of nature.
When elevated into the interior sphere of Heaven.
The sphere exhaled from Hell is like a perpetual endeavour to dissolve and violate marriages.
When good Spirits perceive this delight... from the sphere of an Angel's love... they come into a sweet swoon.
(Spirits recognise others) by the sphere of their life, when they approach.
The sphere of falsity from evil flowing from Hell. Described.
From Heaven was perceived a sphere of truth from good bridling (it). Hence an equilibrium.
This sphere from Heaven was perceived to be from the Lord alone, although it appeared to be from the Angels. Explained.
From each Hell is exhaled a sphere of the cupidities in which are those there. When this sphere is perceived by one in like cupidity... he is filled with delight. Explained.

A spiritual sphere encompasses everyone, which pours forth from the life of the affections and derivative thoughts... Hence such a sphere of life flows forth from every Heavenly Society, and from every infernal one, consequently from all of them together, that is, from the whole Heaven, and the whole Hell. (The equilibrium thence resulting. Explained.)
The sphere flowing from the Hells is wholly a sphere of endeavours to destroy the Divine of the Lord...
The Divine sphere proceeding from the Lord is a perpetual endeavour to save all...
The Divine external sphere of the Word. Signified.
The sphere of the Word from the Lord's Divine good and truth. Signified.

The spiritual Sun is like the sphere... which encompasses each Angel, whereby his presence is presented... and which is not the Angel himself, but is from each and all things of his body, from which substances continually emane in a stream... These substances... excite the atmospheres... and thus present a perception as of his presence...
Thus it is not a different sphere of affections and derivative thoughts... which goes forth and is continued...
There is such a sphere around every Angel, because there is one around the Lord; and that sphere around the Lord is in like manner from Him, and is their Sun.

(The spheres around Angels and Spirits, and the general spheres around Societies, I have seen as thin flame, gross fire, bright cloud, and black cloud; and I have perceived these spheres as odours) by which I have been confirmed that a sphere consisting of substances set free from their bodies encompasses everyone in Heaven and in Hell.

A sphere pours forth (also) from every thing in the Spiritual World. Enumerated. It is similar in the natural world. Explained. The natural world derives this from the Spiritual World, and the Spiritual World from the Divine.

(Natural substances and matters) have brought [with them] by continuation from the substance of the spiritual Sun... the sphere which encompasses the Lord; (and) from this sphere, by continuation from the Sun... have originated the substances and matters from which are earths.
The delight of these affections... encompasses everyone there as his atmosphere; and all are conjoined according to these spheres exhaled from their affections through their thoughts...

The Divine sphere which encompasses the Lord is from His Divine love and Divine wisdom simultaneously; and is represented in the Celestial Kingdom as rubescent... in the Spiritual as cerulescent... and in the Natural as viridescent...
(In the second kind of enchantment) the spiritual sphere of their mind dispelled the spiritual sphere of the other's mind, and suffocated it.
The virgins perceive from their sphere, etc. their quality as to the love of the sex.

A universal conjugial sphere proceeds from the Lord, and pervades the universe... The reason such a sphere of the marriage of good and truth proceeds from Him, is that it is also a sphere of propagation... and this is the same as the Divine Providence for the conservation of the universe... CL 222, General article.

As this universal sphere... inflows into its subjects according to their form... the male receives it... in the understanding, and the female... in the will... and, as this sphere is also a sphere of prolification, it follows that thence is the love of the sex.
That a sphere of lasciviousness pours out from the unchaste, is evident from the Israelitish statutes...
A wife is conjoined with her husband through the sphere of her life which goes forth from her love.
From every man there pours out a spiritual sphere... which applies itself to the natural sphere which is from the body, and they conjoin themselves.
A natural sphere continually flows out from the body... from man, beasts, trees, fruits, flowers, and metals... So in the Spiritual World; but the spheres... there are spiritual...

The spheres which emane from Spirits and Angels are inwardly spiritual, because the affections... and derivative interior perceptions and thoughts are in them. This is the source of all sympathy and antipathy, and of all conjunction and disjunction; and presence and absence there are according to them... and therefore these spheres cause the distances there.

What these spiritual spheres operate in the natural world is known to some. The inclinations of married partners towards each other are from this origin. Unanimous and concordant spheres unite them; and adverse and discordant ones disunite them...
Every part both within and without man renovates itself... and thence is the sphere...
This sphere encompasses a man... thinly on his back, and densely on his breast; and the latter conjoins itself with his respiration. (The effect of this on consorts.) CL 224.
The spheres which go forth from every part of a man, and which are continued amply around him, conjoin or disjoin consorts not only from without, but also from within...
The sphere of love going forth from a wife who is tenderly loved, is perceived in Heaven as sweetly fragrant...
Many spheres proceed from Him. Enumerated... But the universal of them all is the conjugial sphere. Explained.
This conjugial sphere infills the universe, and pervades it from primes to ultimates. Explained.
This sphere is more universal than the sphere of (natural) heat and light. Explained.
This sphere is received by the female sex, and through it is transferred into the male. Explained.
Where there is love truly conjugial, this sphere is received by the wife, and by the husband through her alone. Explained. (This is the test of this love. CL 224:end.)
Where there is love not conjugial, this sphere is received by the wife, but not by the husband through her. Explained.

This conjugial sphere... is Divine in its origin; in its progress into Heaven... is celestial and spiritual; with men is natural; with beasts and birds animal; with worms merely corporeal; and with plants is devoid of life. Moreover it is varied in each subject according to its form.

As this sphere is received immediately by the female sex, and mediately by the male, and is received according to the forms, it follows that this sphere, which is holy in its origin, can, in the subjects, be... turned into the opposite. The sphere opposite to it is called meretricious with such women, and scortatory with such men; and, as these are in Hell, this sphere is thence. But this sphere, also, is of much variety... and every man attracts such a species of it as is in congruity with himself...
Thus a man who does not love his wife, receives this sphere from some other source... yet this also is inspired by her...
This propagative or plastic force in seeds... and in souls... is from the conjugial sphere...

The sphere of love from the wife, and the sphere of understanding from the husband, constantly flows forth; and this [sphere] perfects the conjunctions, is around them with its pleasantness and breathing, and unites them.

For a universal sphere of generating and propagating the celestial things of love, the spiritual things of wisdom, and the derivative natural things of offsprings, proceeds from the Lord, and infils the universal Heaven and the universal world; and this heavenly sphere infills the souls of all mankind, and descends through their minds into their bodies down to the ultimates, and gives the force of generating... with those who suffer themselves to be restored to the primeval state.
Two universal spheres proceed from the Lord to conserve the universe... a sphere of procreating, and a sphere of protecting the things procreated.
The proceeding Divine is called a sphere, because...

All that which flows forth from a subject, and encompasses and environs it, is called a sphere; as the sphere of light and heat around the sun; the sphere of life from a man; the sphere of odour from a shrub; the sphere of attraction from the magnet.

The universal spheres here treated of are from the Lord around Him, and proceed from the (spiritual) Sun. (Thus) proceeds a sphere of heat and light, (that is), a sphere of love and wisdom, to operate ends which are uses. This sphere is distinguished by various names, according to the uses. Enumerated.
These two universal spheres make a one with the sphere of conjugial love and the sphere of the love of infants. Explained.
These two spheres inflow universally and singularly into all things of Heaven and of the world, from primes to ultimates. Explained.
The sphere of the love of infants. Explained. SE 1906.
This sphere affects both the evil and the good. Explained.
This sphere affects, principally, the female sex... Explained.
This sphere is also a sphere of innocence and peace. Explained.
The sphere of innocence inflows into infants, and through them into the parents. Explained.
It also inflows into the souls of the parents, and conjoins itself with the same sphere in the infants... (Explained.)
The sphere of the love of procreating progresses in order... Explained.
There is a sphere of scortatory love, and a sphere of conjugial love. Explained. CL 435, Explained.
These two spheres meet each other in both worlds; but do not conjoin themselves. Explained.
Between these two spheres there is equilibrium; and man is in it. Explained.
Each sphere bears delights with it. Explained.
The sphere of the lust of fornicating... is intermediate between the sphere of scortatory and the sphere of conjugial love, and makes an equilibrium. Explained.
His Sun... consists of the Divine essence, which goes out as a sphere from Him. ISB 5.
The Divine love is Known from its sphere, which pervades the universe...
This universal sphere affects... those who receive this love of God...
The same Divine sphere operates into inanimate things... but through the (natural) sun...
His omnipotence operates within the sphere of the extension of good, which sphere is infinite; for this sphere infils the universe from the inmost. (Its operation explained.)
There continually proceeds from the Lord a Divine celestial sphere towards all who embrace the doctrine of His Church, and obey Him... and want to be instructed by Him.
From this celestial sphere arises a natural sphere, which is one of love towards children; which sphere is most universal, affecting (both animate and inanimate things). Explained.
From the influx of that celestial sphere into the natural world come forth (the wonders of plant life, and the singing of birds). Explained.

The reason evil and good cannot be together... is that in the Spiritual World there exhales from everyone the sphere of his love, which... causes sympathies and antipathies. By these spheres the good are separated from the evil. SE 1847.

The affections and thoughts there make a spiritual sphere around them, which is felt in various ways. But (here) this spiritual sphere is absorbed by the material body; and it encloses itself within the natural sphere, which then pours out of the man.
The spiritual sphere which reigned in those feasts (of charity) was a sphere of love to the Lord and of love towards the neighbour. (Its effects on them.)
For there emanes from every man a spiritual sphere... which interiorly affects his associates, especially at feasts; it emanes through the face and respiration.

(Metals, etc.) absorb the ether, breathe out their native [qualities], reject the obsolete things, and redintegrate themselves with new ones; and hence there is a magnetic sphere round the magnet, an irony one round iron, a coppery one round copper, a silvern one round silver, a golden one round gold, a stony one round stone, a nitrous one round nitre, a sulphurous one round sulphur, and a various one round each particle of... earth from which the inmost of seeds are impregnated. Explained. SE 1846. SE 1847.
If you could feel the sphere of life pouring from everyone's native disposition...
(Effect of) the spheres (there) which flow forth from modern Christianism...
One sphere... takes away faith in the Divine of the Lord's Human. Explained.
A second sphere, which takes away faith, is like a black cloud in winter. Explained.

A third sphere is that of the conjunction of faith and charity, which is so strong that it cannot be resisted; but at this day is abominable. Explained. This sphere invades men (here) also, and extinguishes the conjugial torches between truths and goods. Described.
The Angels complain of these spheres, and pray to the Lord to dissipate them; but... they cannot be dissipated so long as the dragon is on the earth...
These three spheres are like tempest-driven atmospheres... and, being spiritual, they invade minds and drive them.
The spheres of spiritual truths there are as yet few... which is the reason why those Truths are so inconspicuous with men...

There is a sphere elevating all to Heaven which continually proceeds from the Lord, and infils the universal spiritual and natural worlds; it is like a strong current... which secretly carries along a ship. All who believe in the Lord and live according to His precepts enter this sphere or current... But they who do not believe, do not want to enter it...
See Gyre.
On the general sphere of Spirits (before the Last Judgment). Explained.
The sphere of Spirits is now so perverted...
How this general sphere operates into human minds.

(This) general life... diffuses itself, and constitutes a sphere, which is called the sphere of activity, and [extends] itself into the more subtle things of nature. Every Genius and Spirit has his own sphere of activity... so, therefore, have all of them together...
On the general spheres... from the things of God Messiah's Kingdom. Explained.
The rational sphere.
There are also spheres of evil Spirits, (which) fire turned into infernal ones at the Last Judgment. Described.
On the more interior sphere. Described. SE 258.
Tranquil spheres, to be called spheres of ignorance. Explained.
There is a certain sphere exhaling not concordant with my thought. Explained.
On spheres of activity of Spirits and Angels. General article. SE 976. SE 977. SE 978. SE 979. SE 980.
A sphere of spiritual effluvia (from Spirits).
On a circumfused spiritual sphere, and its operation into Spirits. Explained.
A number of Spirits, or Societies, together form a general sphere. Example(s).
That activities of sphere encompass men. Explained.
There is not the smallest particle which has not its own sphere around it; and the conformable parts constitute a general sphere conformable to the parts.
There are spheres of all things...
The sphere of the Lord...
On the sphere of hearing. Explained.
On the spheres of Spirits. Explained.
(The amending of a person's sphere.)

There can be no particular without a general... Thus it is the general sphere which affects... Alan cannot speak, etc., unless there be a certain universal sphere of thoughts. Explained. SE 2003, Explained.
Whence are the spheres which rule the thoughts. SE 2005. SE 2007.
There are indefinite varieties of general spheres... SE 2008.
The spheres proper to Angels, etc., are not mixed with the Lord's spheres...

(There is a sphere of Spirits round man, he being like a solid point in the middle of it, just in the same way as the terracqueous globes are surrounded by their atmospheric spheres. But when the corporeal things are laid aside, man is in that sphere in the same way as is a Spirit.) Further described.

In the atmospheric sphere, incongruous things are dispelled, and so the sphere by its own forces reduces all things to equilibrium. Example(s). Spiritual spheres are the cause of this. (Example of a spiritual sphere being purged in the same way.)
There are spheres which have limits, which Spirits cannot pass. Explained.
The sphere of their activity does not extend far: but ceases at once at a small circumference. Explained.
Deceits occupy this interior sphere...
Insanity reigns in the interior sphere of the World of Spirits. General article.
In the interior sphere of upright Spirits.
All the genera and species of Spirits have their own spheres, into which only like ones can enter. Explained.
All are distinguished not only according to such exterior spheres, but also according to their interior ones...
A bloody sphere. Described. SE 2692. SE 2694, Explained.
In order that a man or Spirit may be in an Angelic sphere, it is necessary that...
On the sphere of those who are worldly (there), and desire to command others. (Its potent effects on others).

Within the sphere of the speech, that is, in the sphere of the thoughts within the speech, in which are interior Spirits... They can transmit themselves into that interior sphere, and this get out of the society of those in the exterior sphere.
On the speech of the Spirits of the interior sphere.
In the interior sphere of nature are thousands of such as are evil... as to the interiors of nature.
In the interior sphere are the ends which cease in the world and self...
On a sphere of persuasions of evil exercised by some Spirits, Explained. SE 2765.
Thus the sphere of a certain love conjoins chickens with their mother.
Persuasion forms a sphere, into which evil Spirits cannot enter. Example(s).
On general spheres. General article.
The four spheres of faith, enumerated. The opposite spheres are also four. SE 2977. SE 2978.
One general sphere contains other general spheres. Explained. SE 2986, Explained.
One sphere also succeeds another.
Of the Spirits in one place, each can he in a different sphere...
The corporeal sphere. Explained.
On the sphere of activity of infants.
Spheres... are presented by odours. Explained.
Spheres of terror, sadness, etc.
Evil Spirits cannot bear a sphere of faith; and therefore the perception of spheres is taken away, diminished, or increased by the Lord...
When they want to explore the angelic sphere... it so penetrates into the interiors of the Spirit that he is turned into such things...
Certain Spirits, or Societies, cannot live in the next purer sphere. Explained.
On spheres. General article.
The only sphere Known to man is odour...
Another sphere known to man, is that he desires this or that food...
But in the other life there are spiritual spheres so perceptible that...
Such spheres are innumerable, being as many as there are Spirits, and Societies.
A general mixed sphere of a number of Spirits is at once discriminated by the Angels...
There is a perceptible sphere of every phantasy; and while a Spirit is mute, and hardly thinks at all, it is perceived by others. They are not aware that they have such a sphere...
When I was extracting what I had written about spheres, not being in perception from a sphere, I did not know what a sphere is, neither did the Spirits around me...

Animals sensate from spheres what they would never perceive in any other way; so that there are spheres in the nature of Things which are quite unknown to man, but which reign with beasts. Thus a dog... Knows his master among a thousand from a sphere of subordination and of friendship... This is ascribed to effluvia...
Animals have a sphere of knowing the quarters of the world... SE 3340.
Animals have also a sphere of gladness...
All animals have spheres of knowing what to eat...
Animals have a sphere of times: as swallows, etc.
Birds have a sphere of building their nests... They have a sphere of bringing up their young.

Such (corporeal and natural) spheres reign with animals; but do not exist with man, because he is in phantasies, (otherwise) he would have these lowest spheres, and also a sphere of Knowing his associate the moment he saw him, that is, his quality...
As to the sphere of faith, he would Know their quality as to faith, like a Spirit, at their first coming... These spheres are human.

Such spheres are of the Lord alone; for they descend from the sphere of faith in Him; from and through this, all the other spheres are distinguished, and they flow forth from it; and therefore spheres of odour correspond...
There are also visual spheres, distinct from those spheres which are of odour; (as) a sphere of grace (visible) as a golden yellow atmosphere...
A sphere seen as of mere human flesh. (It was) one of human affection; thus truly human.

Angels do not know they are in a sphere of the perception of faith, unless the Lord grants them to perceive it, (This is) because they are in it, (just as) gardeners do not perceive the sphere of the odour of flowers...
The odours of those in outermost things... are spheres flowing forth from them. Example(s).
On a sphere of persuasion.
By his phantasies he perverted the spheres.
(The extraordinary sphere of Dippel.) Described.
They perceived my previous quality from my sphere.
On the general sphere of those who suppose Spirits to be like the atmosphere. Described.
One infant, or Angel, can drive away myriads of Spirits; for they cannot endure the sphere of mutual love...
Man's interior man is in this sphere.
The evil who are in the interior sphere...
(His sufferings) when he came into the sphere of angelic Spirits.
The bodily fluids have not their up and down according to the sphere outside the body...
A sphere of abominable adultery exhaled from them.
When I smelled the dung of horses, upright Spirits complained... because there at once occurred a sphere of reasonings from natural things...

Thus... the objects of odours and of the other senses, and also the objects of various thoughts, as also phantasies, all form spheres, to which correspond spiritual and celestial things, consequently their spheres which affect Spirits according to their quality; for spheres are as it weie the atmospheres in which Spirits live.
Evil Spirits want to throw me under the wheels of carriages... the sphere of their endeavour is constantly such...

When I ate butter, certain Spirits... could not bear it, because... it gave rise to a sphere of goods... So (tea pleased them) solely because they derived thence a sphere of there being what is less spiritual. So with many other things I ate and drank...
How the evil in the interior sphere are infested and tortured.
The state of the happy in the interior sphere.
So also various and manifold spheres are formed from Things; as various spheres of goodness...
A sphere was represented as an aura of uses... In such a sphere he began to flee.

Every Spirit, and still more every Society, exhales a sphere of itself, which is from its life of principles; (with) evil Genii, from the life of cupidities. Hence their sphere, which is a sphere as it were of derivative instincts. This sphere is a certain General operating, and when it acts into the memory of a man, it excites thence whatever is accordant... When such a sphere reigns, all things which are excited, however false, appear as true, and confirm... SE 4202, Explained.
(Various visible spheres. Described.)
The quality of the spheres of Spirits which arise from dissent, or consent... Explained.
Such a force of persuading is a general sphere...
When such spheres were shown me by colours...
The great density of the sphere which has to be dissipated...
A sphere of good and truth which cannot yet penetrate through the sphere of persuasions. Representation.
The amount of the sphere may thus be observed.
Round everyone in falsity and evil there are such dense spheres...

These spheres appear as in clear day to good Spirits and Angels, whose spheres cannot possibly accord... and therefore they are dissociated. If they come together, those who have a sphere of falsity and evil around them are greatly tortured; and if, by permission, the spheres of falsity and evil prevail, the good come into temptation, anxieties, and anguish. The respiration is as it were taken away, so that one cannot live in the sphere of the other unless they are miraculously tempered.

There is a spiritual sphere around everyone, as there is a natural sphere, and also a corporeal one. That everyone has this latter, may be evident from the effluvious expiration, which is like a sea around a man.
Hence comes that sphere of self-honour.
How men acquire spheres. SE 4226, Explained.
Such spheres are things which are manifestly perceived (there). Explained.
Such spheres are wont to be turned into spheres of odour...
They are also wont to be turned into visible spheres, and appear as forms of a sphere...
Their sphere is continually of adulteries... Their sphere is turned into an intestinal sphere...
Hence come spheres of faith.
Spheres are such that they affect all who are like them. Example(s). SE 4280.
On spheres of affection.
Certain Societies... were affected by a sphere of the Lord's affections... while other Societies, in the same sphere, could not (be).
Every sphere of affection is attended with there being a certain General...

Very many Spirits transfer themselves into a more subtle sphere... and, when they come into it, it is their interiors which operate... Unless a Spirit is amended before he comes thither, his evil is continued there... and therefore Spirits who are being vastated are not permitted to come into that second sphere until they have been vastated... Very many of the infernals are in this sphere.
When such discourse in the interior sphere... it produces, in the World of Spirits, a sphere of fornication and adultery, and the evil gather to it... and infil the sphere with adulteries, etc.

(The Spirits with a man) think just as the man does, which gives rise to a sphere of thought and affection... in which are all the other Spirits; and, while in it, they speak and are affected variously according to the sphere, each according to his own state. Therefore such Spirits gather to the man as he is himself, and they remain in that sphere, and augment and change it, and excite corresponding things in the man... Such as is the sphere, such are the Spirits...

Through the whole night I was in a spiritual sphere... and in an opposite sphere... The latter sphere continually inflowed, and wanted to destroy the other sphere, but could effect nothing... In such a sphere are those Spirits kept who are being initiated and confirmed in this truth. Explained.
Hence there is a spiritual sphere around a man, not only from the ideas and affections... in the brain, but from... the whole body...
In his sphere, I began to doubt concerning the Divine...

In the descent they are deprived of the holy sphere... which they have on the mountain... They have that sphere of the Lord around them, and they are inside that sphere with their pride, hatreds, etc.; whereas Angels have the sphere of the Lord within them...
When spiritual Angels enter into that (celestial) sphere, they become as if insane... And when Genii... come into their sphere, they are direfully tortured...
From the varieties of objects (the celestial) perceive the presence of the sphere of others; and so from the kind of the affections, they perceive the sphere of the Heaven in which they are.

The spheres of consociations extend themselves almost through the whole Heaven; but with indefinite variety. There are celestial spheres there in which they can be with an affection of joy and love; others in which they can be with another kind of affection of joy and love; and others in which they cannot be. They fall into sadness there. The terminations of their spheres at the sides are there... Thus are the Societies distinguished.
(The Divine sphere which constituted the general advent of the Lord. See Last Judgment.)

The sphere of the Lord's Divine encompassed those whom the Lord protected. This sphere evolved itself towards those who were attacking; some of whom ventured to enter it, but they were suddenly smitten with such anxiety of heart...

Those who appear like cats can be in the sphere of the Lord's Divine without being tortured... Such can ascend into some of the Heavens, and cannot be driven away, like others, by the angelic sphere. Explained.
On a certain person's sphere which... poured forth poisonous sarcasms...
His sphere was rolled round him like a roll. Described.
The reason (they are thus magically bound) is that the Genii... form a sphere about the man, and thus adjoin infernals...
The Divine sphere of ends and uses. Explained.
The abominable sphere of the love of self. Explained. (Its effects on me. DMin 4678.)
An inundation by various spheres of the Hells, which spheres are directed by the Lord, and then produce anxieties and temptations...
A conversation about spheres.
A sphere proceeds from every Angel and Spirit... they have garments according to this sphere.
These spheres are turned into such appearances.
Around every Angel is a sphere... which pours out to a great distance... it is the extension of his life outside of him, and this extension is effected by means of the spiritual atmosphere...
But around the Lord is a Divine sphere, which near Him appears as a Sun... This sphere is the Divine which proceeds from Him, which in its essence is Divine truth. AE 941.
For the life of everyone... forms a sphere around him... Hence by the woman encompassed with the sun, is signified...

When man is in the exercise of charity, the sphere of all his affections and thoughts is like thin water... In this sphere are all things of his mind in the complex. Explained... The same spiritual sphere manifests itself before the sight in (other) representative forms. AE 865.

All things in the world... pour out a sphere, which is sometimes sensated from afar, as that from animals in forests, which dogs keenly scent... But (all) these are natural exhalations. In like manner in the Spiritual World. Explained.
There is not a single thought of a Spirit or man which does not communicate with some Society by this sphere...
Two opposite spheres encompass man; one from Hell, the other from Heaven. Explained. AE 1014:2, Explained. Ath 201, (Explained.)
When they descend into the lower sphere in which Angels are as to their bodies...
A sphere flowing from his love encompasses every man and Angel. Explained... This sphere has extension into the Heavens... or into the Hells. Explained.
But the sphere of the Lord's love has infinite extension, and creates the Heavens themselves.
Man acquires this sphere in the world...
There is an extension of the sphere from the Divine into the universe...
The sphere proceeding from Angels extends itself into much of Heaven.
The proceeding Divine... is formed successively into spheres, the last of which is the (natural) atmosphere.
The Holy Spirit is the same as the Divine sphere, if by this is meant the Divine love and wisdom...
